name: Rúben Achola-Szervánszky
role: Bio-waste disposal technician for Aurochs Medical Complex
location: Aurochs Medical Complex, service sublevel corridors, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Rúben is lean and angular, with the particular pallor of someone who works night shifts in fluorescent-lit sublevels, though his Ugandan-Hungarian ancestry gives his skin a warm undertone that fights back. He keeps his head shaved close and has a constellation of small bioluminescent freckle-mods across his left temple and jaw — a cosmetic geneware treatment he had done at eighteen that pulses faintly blue when his heart rate elevates, which he finds mortifying in tense situations. He moves through the hospital's service corridors like someone who has memorized every turn and wants to be finished before anyone notices him.

He is sharper than his job suggests and acutely aware of that gap, which produces a chip on his shoulder he tries to sand down with self-deprecating humor. He has worked the bio-waste runs at Aurochs for four years and in that time has accidentally become something of an expert in what the hospital throws away — which procedures are spiking, which departments are over-ordering which compounds, which disposal manifests do not match the volumes going into the incinerators. He notices things. He has not yet decided what to do with what he notices.

core_fears: being dismissed for the rest of his life as someone who carries bags of medical trash
that the things he has noticed in the disposal manifests mean something serious enough to get him hurt
core_desires: to get the medical tech certification and be seen differently
to understand why the numbers do not add up without getting himself killed for asking
coping_mechanisms: dark humor about his job before anyone else can make the joke
online coursework as proof to himself that he is going somewhere
a running mental catalog of anomalies he has observed, organized by department
blind_spots: underestimates how much information he actually possesses and how dangerous it could be
assumes people look down on him when some of them genuinely do not
psychology.secret: For three months he has been photographing disposal manifest discrepancies and storing them in an encrypted personal archive. One department — the gene therapy research sublevel — is disposing of biological material that does not appear anywhere in the official treatment logs. He has not told anyone. He has not deleted the photos.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Casual and quick; uses hospital jargon accurately but pretends it is accidental; self-deprecating humor as deflection
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when nervous, which is often; sentences sometimes outrun their endings
verbal_tics: 'Not my department.' (ironic, since everything is technically his department)
example_lines: 'I just move the bags. Extremely important bags. The most important bags in this building, arguably.'
'There's a lot you can learn about a hospital from what it throws away. Not that I would know anything about that.'
'Look, the bioluminescent things were a phase. I was eighteen. I cannot be held responsible for being eighteen.'

story_hooks: The gene therapy sublevel disposal discrepancies begin to include something that is clearly not standard biological waste — a material Rúben does not recognize and cannot find in any database he has legitimate access to

A Helix Biosystems compliance auditor begins asking questions about disposal logs specifically, and makes a point of talking to junior staff — including Rúben — in a way that feels less like routine audit and more like they are looking for a specific leak
narrative_function: Unexpected information source; has knowledge of hospital operations, waste streams, and disposal records that no one suspects he has; local color for the unglamorous underside of the medical system; potential whistleblower
augmentations: Bioluminescent freckle-mods on left temple and jaw (cosmetic geneware, pulses blue under stress); standard-issue hazmat-rated subdermal filter implant in respiratory tract (employer-provided, technically owned by Aurochs)
daily_life: Night shift, 2200 to 0600. Runs bio-waste collection from surgical floors, gene therapy wards, and augmentation recovery suites, processes and logs materials, operates the sublevel incinerators. Sleeps days in a rented room in Ironvein. Spends two days a week taking online coursework toward a medical technician certification.
affiliation: Aurochs Medical Complex (contracted waste disposal staff, Tier 2 worker classification)

decision_rules: Keep your head down until you understand what you are looking at
Never confront authority directly; deflect, joke, leave
Document before you decide what the documentation means
escalation_ladder: Physical absence — finds reasons to be elsewhere
If truly cornered, blurts the truth unexpectedly and then panics about having done it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Deflects with jokes; assesses quickly for whether they think less of him for his job
interpersonal_modes.friends: Generous and genuinely funny; drops the performance; stays up too late talking

stress_responses.medium: Bioluminescent mods start pulsing; he becomes hyperaware of this and it makes it worse
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent and still; humor evaporates; starts thinking very fast

contradictions: Insists he does not care about being underestimated while obsessively cataloging evidence of his own competence
habits: Photographs disposal manifests on his personal device at end of each shift
Reviews online course material during 0300 quiet hours in the sublevel
Counts bags by department; notices when counts are wrong
breaking_points: Someone at Aurochs figuring out that he has the encrypted archive
Being threatened by someone he outranks in knowledge but not power

timeline.event: Born in Ironvein to a Ugandan-Hungarian family; father worked port logistics
Got bioluminescent freckle-mods; has regretted the choice in high-stress situations ever since
Began contracted waste disposal work at Aurochs Medical Complex
Three months into building an encrypted archive of disposal manifest discrepancies; has not told anyone

carried_weapons: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'
